labels.label: Cylinder Misfire
labels.description: Intermittent combustion failure on one cylinder. Charge passes unburned; that cylinder stops making torque.
signature: Shaft power deficit vs commanded MAP

labels.label: Spark Plug Fouling
labels.description: Carbon/lead deposits shunt the spark gap. Combustion becomes late and partial before it fails outright.
signature: Slow EGT decay on one cylinder
Fuel flow up for same power

labels.label: Detonation / Combustion Instability
labels.description: Uncontrolled end-gas auto-ignition. Pressure spikes hammer the piston crown and dump heat into the head.
signature: CHT rising fast on all cylinders
Correlated with high MAP + lean mixture

labels.label: Ignition Timing Drift
labels.description: Crank/cam sensor phase error walks the ignition map retarded. Burn completes in the exhaust port.
signature: Power deficit at constant fuel flow

labels.label: Exhaust Valve Leakage / Compression Loss
labels.description: Burnt seat lets combustion gas escape during compression. Cylinder loses trapped mass and torque.
signature: Power deficit not explained by fuel

labels.label: Injector Clogging
labels.description: Deposits restrict the injector orifice. That cylinder runs progressively leaner than the ECU believes.

labels.label: Injector Stuck Open / Leaking
labels.description: Injector fails to seat. Raw fuel enters continuously - that cylinder floods and quenches.
signature: Fuel flow high for commanded power
Lambda rich, EGT dropping on that cylinder

labels.label: Fuel Pump Degradation / Starvation
labels.description: Pump output falls below rail demand. The engine leans out first at high power, where flow demand peaks.

labels.label: Fuel Contamination / Water Ingress
labels.description: Water or low-octane fuel in the rail. Combustion becomes erratic and knock margin disappears.
signature: Intermittent EGT dropouts on multiple cylinders

labels.label: Oil Pressure Loss
labels.description: Pump wear, a leak or a blocked pickup. Bearing hydrodynamic film collapses - this is the fastest path to engine loss.
signature: Oil temperature rising (loss of heat carry-away)

labels.label: Oil Degradation / Viscosity Breakdown
labels.description: Thermal breakdown and shear thin the oil. Pressure sags at temperature while wear metals climb.
signature: Oil pressure low only when hot
Oil temp elevated at constant power

labels.label: Coolant Loss / Cooling Degradation
labels.description: Coolant level or pump flow falls. Head rejection capacity drops and CHT walks up on every cylinder.
signature: CHT rising in lockstep on all cylinders

labels.label: Radiator / Oil Cooler Duct Blockage
labels.description: Debris or icing restricts cooling airflow. Rejection falls off with airspeed dependence intact.
signature: Coolant AND oil temperature both rising

labels.label: Main / Rod Bearing Wear
labels.description: Babbitt loss increases running clearance. Broadband vibration rises and oil pressure bleeds off through the clearance.
signature: Oil pressure sagging at constant RPM

labels.label: Propeller Imbalance / Blade Damage
labels.description: Mass or aerodynamic imbalance in the propeller disc. A clean 1-per-rev excitation transmitted through the gearbox.

labels.label: Reduction Gearbox Wear
labels.description: Gear-tooth pitting and slipper-clutch wear. Energy appears at the gear-mesh frequency, not at engine order.

labels.label: Turbocharger / Wastegate Fault
labels.description: Wastegate stuck open or turbine efficiency lost. Boost collapses - and it collapses hardest at altitude.
signature: MAP below scheduled boost for throttle

labels.label: Induction Leak / Filter Clogging
labels.description: Unmetered air past the sensor, or a restricted filter starving the compressor. Either way MAP no longer matches the fuel schedule.
signature: Lambda lean at low power (leak) or rich at high (restriction)

labels.label: Alternator Failure / Battery Discharge
labels.description: Generator output lost. The bus runs on battery alone - ECU, injectors and ignition are on a countdown.
signature: ECU brownout risk on time horizon

labels.label: Voltage Regulator Fault / Overcharge
labels.description: Regulator loses control of field current. Bus voltage climbs and cooks the battery and the ECU rails.

labels.label: CHT/EGT Sensor Drift
labels.description: Thermocouple junction degradation. The *indication* walks away while the engine itself is healthy - the classic false-alarm generator.
signature: Indicated CHT/EGT diverging from physics-model prediction
No corresponding power, fuel or vibration change
Residual grows monotonically, not with load

labels.label: Sensor Dropout / Open Circuit
labels.description: Open or shorted sensor circuit. The channel goes invalid - the twin must keep flying on its model estimate.
signature: Zero variance on a live engine

labels.label: Oil Pressure Sensor Fault
labels.description: Transducer reads low while true pressure is normal. Distinguishing this from a real oil emergency is the whole point of a twin.
signature: Oil temperature NORMAL (a real loss would heat it)
Model residual isolates the sensor, not the pump
